video_title: Cavs Shootaround | Evan Mobley & Tyrese Proctor Media Availability | 11.02.2026

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on defensive adjustments to team injuries
quotes.excerpt: we just got to do a great job team wise defensively being in the gaps
quotes.quote: They definitely got a lot of injuries but can't take them lightly. They're still a contender and have great players. So with Shay we just got to do a great job team wise defensively being in the gaps, being over to help, showing a lot of help for him because he's a great scorer. So it's going to be a real team battle.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on the defensive game plan against OKC: We have to do a great job team wise being in the gaps and showing a lot of help for Shai because he is a great scorer. It is going to be a real team battle.

structured.context: Evan Mobley discusses the defensive game plan for facing Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the injury-depleted Thunder.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on defending big men who play outside the paint
quotes.excerpt: it's a little bit tougher especially for the bigs because he doesn't necessarily get all the way
quotes.quote: It's a little bit tougher especially for the bigs because he doesn't necessarily get all the way to the paint. So we got to figure out when we're going to help and when we're not going to help. But today we talked about our game plan on when exactly that is and we're going to play it well.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on defending perimeter bigs: It is a little bit tougher because he does not necessarily get all the way to the paint. We have to figure out when we are going to help and when we are not.

structured.context: Evan Mobley explains the team's defensive adjustments for guarding big men who play away from the paint.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on learning from film and personal coaching
quotes.excerpt: he's always just asking questions after the film to whoever's personal coaches
quotes.quote: In film and whenever we're watching something and studying a player or anything, he's always just asking questions after the film to whoever's personal coaches, whether that's us or his personal coach. He's always really trying to learn. The small little details that you're not necessarily getting taught, he's still worried about and trying to figure out. I think that's a great quality for a rookie coming in.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley praises a rookie teammate for his work ethic: He is always really trying to learn. The small little details that you are not necessarily getting taught, he is still worried about and trying to figure out.

structured.context: Evan Mobley praises the work ethic and learning habits of a rookie teammate during film study.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley

quotes.quote: That we're going to be a great team. I think we have all the pieces, all the right players and I think we're playing well together and we're only going to get better. So I think we're going to be a great team this year.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on the Cavs outlook: I think we have all the pieces, all the right players and I think we are playing well together and we are only going to get better. We are going to be a great team this year.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on integrating new players into the team system
quotes.excerpt: it takes a little time to get fully adjusted but I think we're getting there each game
quotes.quote: It takes a little time to get fully adjusted but I think we're getting there each game and he's making better plays and setting us up, bigs and wings, every single time he drives. So we're getting accustomed to how he plays and how he likes to get into the paint and I think that's going to be beneficial for us.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on integrating new playmakers: It takes a little time to get fully adjusted but we are getting there each game. We are getting accustomed to how he plays and how he likes to get into the paint.

structured.context: Evan Mobley discusses the process of integrating a new player into the team's offensive system.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on learning professional habits from teammates
quotes.excerpt: not skipping steps, not taking days off even if mentally it's tough or physically it's tough
quotes.quote: Just the details, not skipping steps, not taking days off even if mentally it's tough or physically it's tough. I think that's the biggest thing that I've seen and we do every shootaround we work together. So just getting off the dribble shots, catch and shoot shots, different footwork, because no shot in the game is going to be the same, so just trying to replicate that in practice.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Proctor on his professional development: The biggest thing is not skipping steps and not taking days off even if mentally or physically it is tough. We are just trying to replicate game shots in practice.

structured.context: Tyrese Proctor describes his focus on professional habits and replicating game-speed shots during practice.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on his impact and comfort level as a rookie
quotes.excerpt: I feel real comfortable out there obviously with a whole bunch of different lineups
quotes.quote: It's been good. Trying to come in and impact when I'm on the court. I think that's a big thing. Our starters have been doing a great job getting off to strong starts and it's my job to come in and match that and if not exceed that. So I think I've had a great start to the year. I feel real comfortable out there obviously with a whole bunch of different lineups, so just trying to pick and choose my spots and get everyone involved at the same time.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Proctor on his rookie role: Our starters have been doing a great job getting off to strong starts and it is my job to come in and match that and if not exceed that. I feel real comfortable out there.

structured.context: Tyrese Proctor reflects on his comfort level and role as a rookie coming off the bench.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on defensive discipline and team reliance
quotes.excerpt: keep them hands out on you got them. I think that's the biggest thing
quotes.quote: Keep them hands out on you got them. I think that's the biggest thing. I think I had one possession I fouled him. So just staying disciplined and playing my defense what I've been doing all year and relying on the people behind you to have your back and just play team defense. I think that's a big thing that we're going to rely on tonight and moving forward.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Proctor on defensive discipline: Staying disciplined and playing my defense and relying on the people behind you to have your back and just play team defense. That is a big thing we are going to rely on tonight.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on how strength training has improved his game
quotes.excerpt: my rebounding specifically it's helped me in that just crushing the glass trying to be a better rebounder
quotes.quote: It's been huge. I think all parts of my game, I think my rebounding specifically it's helped me in that just crushing the glass trying to be a better rebounder and it also allows me to push the ball in transition to keep that pace that we want to play with. Kenny's emphasized that a number of times and I feel like if I'm getting rebounds defensively, I mean and offensively, mainly defensively, can just push the pace in transition, get better shots, get better shots and then I think defensively as well just being able to bully screens, early hits, early bumps and enforcing my will defensively.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Proctor says strength training has been huge for his game: It has helped me specifically in crushing the glass and allowed me to push the ball in transition to keep that pace that we want to play with.

structured.context: Tyrese Proctor explains how strength training has improved his rebounding and ability to push the pace in transition.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on the team's next-man-up mentality
quotes.excerpt: we do a great job of just having next man mentality
quotes.quote: I think we got a lot of dogs on the team. I think we do a great job of just having next man mentality. A couple guys out here and there, but I think everyone's on the same page with details, habits, just our overall what we want to do overall offensively and defensively. I think everyone's buying in on that and any given night anyone can go off. We saw it last game with the two bigs in JA and Ev and I think guys are willing to sacrifice different things for a team win.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Proctor on the Cavs depth: We got a lot of dogs on the team. We do a great job of having next man mentality. Everyone is buying in and any given night anyone can go off.

structured.context: Tyrese Proctor highlights the team's next-man-up mentality and the contributions of Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on working with Omar Cook
quotes.excerpt: he's a great player he's a facilitator and a scoring point guard
quotes.quote: A little bit of everything. Him being a great player, him being a facilitator and a scoring point guard. I think just being able to see the floor, he's on me in the game whatever he sees and we have honest conversations and I think he's been great for me just working with him post practice all the time, watching film all the time, just giving me his takes and relaying messages that might be spoken from the other coaches as well and I think balance, defensive, it's just a little bit of everything.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Proctor on working with Omar Cook: He has been great for me just working with him post practice all the time, watching film and relaying messages that might be spoken from the other coaches as well.

structured.context: Tyrese Proctor discusses the mentorship and guidance he receives from coach Omar Cook.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Proctor
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Proctor on the team's ability to close games
quotes.excerpt: there's no off nights in the NBA so coming in with the same mindset to just kill
quotes.quote: They obviously have players out but the league's so good. So like I said with our guys, next man up mentality and I think they do a great job of emphasizing that and there's no off nights in the NBA. So coming in with the same mindset to just kill every time we step on the court and I think just enforcing that will offensively, defensively and overall.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Proctor on closing games: There are no off nights in the NBA. Coming in with the same mindset to just kill every time we step on the court and enforcing that will offensively and defensively.

structured.context: Tyrese Proctor discusses the team's mindset regarding the need to stay aggressive despite opponents missing players.
